settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII urban realism in Berlin, April 1945. Soviet Red Army infantry POV, shattered apartment blocks, tram lines, smoke, brick dust, courtyards, cellars and exhausted street movement. Non-graphic, restrained and historically grounded.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. Nearby friendlies remain Soviet Red Army. German defenders remain clearly separate in opposing streets or buildings. Avoid triumphalist posing and constant firing; use quiet interiors, civilian-empty spaces, rubble navigation and tired human details.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person urban-endgame reenactment with dust, smoke, broken glass, masonry texture, echoing interiors and cinematic scale reveals.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP14 — Berlin: The Last Streets
movie.storySummary: A fictional Soviet infantryman moves through shattered Berlin streets and courtyards, pauses in ruined interiors, crosses a rubble-choked avenue and reaches a higher position as evening settles over the damaged city.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Focus on physical presence in ruined urban space, dust, echo, fatigue and restrained movement. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Brick Canyon
scenes.actionDescription: He walks close to a shattered wall behind Soviet infantry.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Soviet sleeve, rubble street, damaged tram wires, friendly soldiers ahead, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow wall-side movement. Audio: boots, debris, distant artillery, breath.

scenes.title: Broken Tram
scenes.actionDescription: He passes a burned-out tram and peers through its broken windows.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on tram frame, broken glass, smoke beyond, no enemy visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pass and glance through tram. Audio: wind, metal creak, distant battle.

scenes.title: Courtyard Entry
scenes.actionDescription: He steps through a blown doorway into a dim courtyard.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dark doorway into rubble courtyard, Soviet friendlies crossing ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Bright street to dim courtyard transition. Audio: footsteps echo, dust, breath.

scenes.title: Dust on Hands
scenes.actionDescription: He brushes brick dust from gloves after steadying on a wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty gloves, cracked plaster, rifle resting at side.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close hand detail. Audio: grit, distant guns, breathing.

scenes.title: Opposite Window
scenes.actionDescription: He watches a dark opposing window across courtyard without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low cover, dark distant window, Soviet position clearly foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still watch. Audio: wind through broken glass, distant shots.

scenes.title: Cellar Steps
scenes.actionDescription: He descends into cellar and rests one hand on rail.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person cracked stairwell, hand on dusty rail, low light.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow descent. Audio: stair creak, muffled artillery, breath.

scenes.title: Small Drink
scenes.actionDescription: He drinks from canteen while seated against wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen, dusty knees, rifle on floor, Soviet boots nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet drink. Audio: swallowing, distant rumble.

scenes.title: Back to Street
scenes.actionDescription: He emerges and makes one short dash across rubble-choked avenue.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint over bricks and tram rails, rifle low, Soviet cover ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Fast crossing then stop. Audio: boots, rubble, breath, distant bursts.

scenes.title: Wall Shadow
scenes.actionDescription: He leans in wall shadow and catches breath.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on soot-black wall, rubble street in bright haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still. Audio: breath, wind, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Street Map
scenes.actionDescription: He unfolds a small street map and traces route with finger.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person map over dusty crate, Soviet sleeve, rifle off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close map check. Audio: paper, distant battle.

scenes.title: Stairwell Climb
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs a cracked apartment stairway using rail for balance.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person broken stairs, hand on rail, plaster dust.
scenes.videoPrompt: Heavy climb. Audio: steps, creak, breath.

scenes.title: Roofline Reveal
scenes.actionDescription: He steps to broken window and sees Berlin rooftops through smoke.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wide city reveal, damaged roofs, smoke columns, Soviet position foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Confined room to wide city reveal. Audio: wind, distant guns.

scenes.title: No Celebration
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers rifle and simply watches the ruined city.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands on windowsill, rifle lowered at edge, gray-orange haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still reflective hold. Audio: wind, distant artillery, breath.

scenes.title: Evening Smoke
scenes.actionDescription: He wipes dust from goggles or eyes as light warms.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty glove near face, smoky sunset through broken window.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow wipe and exhale. Audio: wind, room creaks.

scenes.title: Down Again
scenes.actionDescription: He turns from window and descends to rejoin the squad.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person turn into dim stairwell, Soviet soldiers waiting below.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn and first step down. Audio: boots, gear, tired breath. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite Soviet Red Army infantryman
characters.description: Anonymous Soviet infantryman during the Battle of Berlin, April 1945.
characters.mainOutfit: Red Army field uniform, steel helmet, web gear, infantry weapon

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain Soviet Red Army. German defenders remain clearly separate. Preserve dust, soot, fatigue and urban-position continuity.
